comparison.objective: Fit and hand-tighten a keyed oxygen regulator yoke on a cylinder; candidate sets and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Blind pin alignment, yoke seating, and holding the assembly square while turning a T-screw; no driver-held adjustment screw beneath a jam nut.
comparison.success_condition: Requires pin insertion, washer alignment, clamp torque, release, and stability; candidate requires angular accuracy, lock retention, and repeated actuation.
comparison.reason: Although both combine stabilization with screw tightening, the regulator tests keyed insertion and clamp formation rather than preserving a pre-set screw position during locknut tightening.
